passages.context: Printed p. 493 was inspected directly as a page image. Donaldson's historical English rendering confirms the reader/exorcist contrast and the sequence of categories not ordained qua category, while its note records a Coptic variant at VIII.26.3. It is used only as a translation aid to the Greek control and does not establish original wording, universal practice, frequency, office continuity, direct descent, or current law.
